business_context.region: Melbourne (base: Epping VIC showroom); Sydney; Queensland (stated target area, Q11)
business_context.positioning: Own-brand outdoor-living retailer (Delta / Skyflex / U7 range). Established pergola/louvre SEO: 20 tracked keywords + strong GSC footprint (/pergola-kits/ 19.6k impr, /outdoor-pergolas/ 26k impr, /louvred-pergolas-sydney/ 74 clicks). EXPANSION pivots into 4 new product lines per client Q10 ('I would like to focus on these newly added products as well') — ADDITIVE to, not replacing, the pergola core.
business_context.site_reality: Live WooCommerce site. New-product PAGES exist (/product/u7-smartoilet/ pos 5.95 · /product/delta-commercial-folding-arm/ pos 5.47 · delta-pro-retractable-roof · skyflex-bbq-pods · skyflex-4k-android-smart-outdoor-tv) but have near-zero keyword targeting / organic visibility. Homepage + primary nav are pergola-centric; the new products have NO category-page presence. The 20 tracked keywords are all pergola/louvre, geo-modified to Melbourne + Sydney only — QLD untapped, and the biggest bare pergola quick-wins (pergola melbourne 3,247 impr pos 16; pergolas sydney 2,442 impr pos 7; louvre roof melbourne pos 9.3) are NOT among the tracked 20.
business_context.ground_truth_sources: GSC (siteOwner on https://skyflex.au/; 90d pull: 75 queries + 40 pages + 4 sitemaps), SE Ranking project 9256979 (20 tracked kw, read via blog-topics namespace — kwr PROJECT_* unregistered this session), Google Ads AU volume probes (new-product categories), Playwright nav crawl, questionnaire form Be8psUMW. Existing-20 staged at raw/existing_keywords.json.
business_context.strategy_note: Client Q10 = 4 new products, additive ('as well'), no per-product split specified. Delivery brief = 'find quick wins through GSC'. Reconciled with analyst 2026-07-01: 6 new-product + 4 pergola-net-new. New-product pages already rank ~top-6 invisibly → existing-page-optimisation is the fastest ROI. Pergola slots target UNTRACKED GSC quick-wins + QLD geo-expansion (both net-new vs the tracked 20). Demand-weighted per-product split is analyst-approved, not client-specified.

package.split_rationale: 6 new-product (client Q10) + 4 pergola-net-new (GSC quick-wins + QLD geo). Analyst-approved 2026-07-01.

silos.label: Smart Toilet (U7 Smartoilet)
silos.demand_signal: smart toilet 2,400/mo · smart toilet australia 880 · smart toilet seat 590 · electric bidet 480 (bidet toilet 9,900 broad)
silos.eligibility_evidence: Product page ranks pos 5.95 with 63 impr/90d — striking-distance quick-win (pos in [4,15] AND impr>=50); strong category demand (smart toilet 2,400/mo). 3rd-party brands (Toto, Kohler, TOTO Washlet) excluded.

silos.label: Folding Arm Awning (Delta Commercial)
silos.demand_signal: folding arm awning 1,600/mo · retractable awning 6,600 (broad category) · electric awning 720 · motorized retractable awning 110
silos.eligibility_evidence: Product page ranks pos 5.47 but 0 clicks / 15 impr — ranks yet invisible, needs keyword anchor + optimisation. Flagship commercial new product. folding arm awning 1,600/mo; retractable awning 6,600/mo umbrella.

silos.label: Outdoor TV (Skyflex 4K Android)
silos.demand_signal: outdoor tv 2,900/mo · outdoor television 2,900 · weatherproof outdoor tv 260 · outdoor smart tv 40
silos.eligibility_evidence: Solid category demand (outdoor tv 2,900/mo) but product page has near-zero organic visibility — content/keyword gap. 3rd-party brands (Samsung Terrace, Sylvox, Sunbrite) excluded; target the generic weatherproof/outdoor-tv head.

silos.label: BBQ Pod (Skyflex BBQ Pods)
silos.eligibility_evidence: Niche/emerging category (bbq pod 720/mo); product page needs a keyword anchor. Smallest of the 4 new lines → single head keyword.

silos.label: Pergola GSC quick-wins (untracked)
silos.target_page: existing pergola/louvre pages (e.g. /outdoor-pergolas/, /louvred-pergolas-sydney/, or a new louvre-roof page)
silos.demand_signal: pergola melbourne 3,247 impr pos 16.1 · pergolas melbourne 3,912 impr pos 15.4 · pergolas sydney 2,442 impr pos 7.3 · louvre pergola melbourne 791 impr pos 7.0 · louvre roof melbourne 318 impr pos 9.3
silos.eligibility_evidence: GSC striking-distance queries NOT among the 20 tracked (tracked set is all geo-modified 'louvred/outdoor/aluminium pergolas melbourne/sydney'). These bare/variant pergola heads have high impressions on page 1-2 — fastest-ROI quick-wins that satisfy the delivery brief's GSC directive. NET-NEW vs tracked 20.

silos.label: Pergola QLD geo-expansion (Brisbane)
silos.target_page: new QLD/Brisbane pergola landing page(s) replicating the Melb/Syd template
silos.demand_signal: Brisbane/QLD pergola demand (to be volume-validated in Phase 3a); Melb/Syd template proven (client ranks pos 7-16 for pergola city terms)
silos.eligibility_evidence: Existing pergola template proven in Melbourne + Sydney; QLD is a client-stated target area (Q11) with ZERO current pergola tracking or content. Geo-expansion of a proven cluster to a new city in the client's delivery network.

tracks.distribution_note: Deviates from the 30/30/30/10 upgrade default because of this client's specific mix — the new-product pages that already rank invisibly favour existing-page-optimisation, and the real GSC quick-wins live in the pergola space.
